patterns.label: Terminal, guest tips
patterns.who: Till A, Till B, Till C, Till D, Till E, Till F, Till G, Till H, Till I, Till K, Till Q
patterns.desc: One Pay button opens the method choice, card hands off to a terminal and the guest picks the tip on a guest-facing device.

patterns.label: One-tap usual method
patterns.who: Till A, Till B, Till P
patterns.desc: A shortcut sends the usual payment straight to the terminal with no method sheet.

patterns.label: Staff key the tip
patterns.who: Till J, Till L, Till M
patterns.desc: Staff enter the tip on the till before choosing the method.

patterns.label: Tip from overpayment
patterns.who: Till O, Till B, Till E, Till K
patterns.desc: Staff enter more than the total and the excess is booked as a tip.

patterns.label: Documented decline path
patterns.who: Till D, Till F, Till G, Till S
patterns.desc: What happens on a decline is documented: pay the remaining balance, end the attempt, or back to the method choice.

patterns.label: Guest pays on phone
patterns.desc: The guest scans a table QR and pays and tips from their own phone; staff see the check close.

patterns.label: Receipt choice, one tap
patterns.who: Till A, Till D, Till F, Till G, Till I, Till J, Till K, Till Q, Till M
patterns.desc: After payment one screen offers print, email, text or QR with a one-tap No receipt, and the payment closes the order.

patterns.label: QR digital receipt
patterns.who: Till A, Till M, Till H, Till C
patterns.desc: A QR code gives the guest a digital receipt with nothing typed.

patterns.label: Email to attached customer
patterns.who: Till B, Till Q, Till A
patterns.desc: With a customer attached, the receipt goes to their stored email automatically.

patterns.label: Print only
patterns.desc: The till prints the receipt, automatically if set, with no digital option.

patterns.label: Guest picks on screen
patterns.desc: The guest chooses on their own screen, with No receipt as the default.

patterns.label: Automatic, zero taps
patterns.desc: The receipt is emailed or texted, the check closes from the payment event and a review is asked for.

patterns.label: Detect, show, auto-sync
patterns.who: Till C, Till D, Till E, Till G, Till J, Till Q
patterns.desc: The till detects the outage, shows a lasting indicator, publishes what is blocked and syncs on reconnect.

patterns.label: Cards offline, own risk
patterns.who: Till C, Till D, Till H, Till F, Till I, Till K
patterns.desc: Card payments are stored offline and authorised on reconnect, with declines at the merchant's risk.

patterns.label: Cards blocked offline
patterns.who: Till G, Till J, Till L, Till Q
patterns.desc: Card payments are blocked while offline; other selling continues.

patterns.label: Manual offline mode
patterns.who: Till A, Till L, Till E
patterns.desc: Staff switch the till into an offline or backup mode by hand, sometimes before the outage.

patterns.label: iPads talk locally
patterns.desc: Devices keep talking over the local network, so orders and the bar screen carry on without the internet.

patterns.label: Pause until reconnected
patterns.desc: An unstable-connection popup pauses actions until the connection recovers.
